title: DayZ Badlands Collector's Vinyl Box Set Available Exclusively at IGN Store
take: DayZ fans, get ready to dive even deeper into the Badlands! Bohemia Interactive just launched a killer collector's vinyl box set for the new expansion, packed with some seriously cool loot. For $140, you’re not just getting the DayZ and Badlands soundtracks on sweet 2LP vinyl; there's also an A4 art print, a Morse code poster for new radio gameplay (how awesome is that?!), and three lore-based patches – plus a Steam code for the game and a premium presentation box! This treasure chest of DayZ goodness is exclusive to the IGN Store in North America and Bohemia's own store for EU folks. Just remember, it won't ship until December 2026, so you've got a bit of a wait, but clearly, this is one to pre-order before it vanishes!

title: PlayStation Shadowdrops Saros Zenith Update With Boss Rush, New Game+ and Fancy Golden Crown Powerups
take: Housemarque just dropped a surprise update for Saros, and it’s a golden ticket to more intense fun! The Zenith update brings a Boss Rush mode for leaderboard glory and New Game+ that throws mysterious Eclipse Layers and even deadlier enemies your way. But the coolest part? Your character, Arjun, gets a flashy golden crown and glowing armor the more challenges you activate – talk about flexing! Plus, Housemarque added some awesome accessibility features, like slowing down projectiles and auto-fire, so everyone can jump into the high-octane action. Get ready to crown your run and climb those leaderboards!

title: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
take: Battlefield 6 players have been quick to call out some hilarious cosmetic blunders in Season 5! Turns out the "Secuty" typo on an armband, which had fans screaming about AI, is indeed getting a fix next month. But get this – that wild "Midnight Mirage" skin sporting five pistol holsters? That's an *intentional* nod to action movie absurdity, according to the devs! So while one gaffe gets corrected, you'll still be able to live out your multi-pistol fantasies. It’s cool to see Battlefield Studios acknowledge player feedback, even if they’re sticking to their guns (pun intended!) on the over-the-top designs.

title: Apparent Leaked Footage Shows Canceled Assassin's Creed Game Set in Qin Dynasty China
take: Hold up, did we just get a peek at a *canceled* Assassin's Creed game that looked absolutely epic? Leaked footage of "Assassin's Creed Destiny" shows a massive open-world AC set in Qin Dynasty China, complete with a fancy umbrella weapon and player choice for protagonists! While we’re getting the mobile-focused Assassin’s Creed Jade in the same setting, this console/PC version looks like it could have been a true historical playground, focusing on Liu Bang's rise to power with a distinct yin-yang UI. It's a real shame this Ubisoft-Tencent partnership never saw the light of day, especially when big upcoming titles like Hexe are reportedly having their own development woes.

title: Activision Thinks GTA 6 Will Actually Help Modern Warfare 4: 'No Offense to Zelda, but [GTA and COD] Are the 2 Biggest Games of the Year'
take: Forget the "Barbenheimer" of gaming, Activision thinks the launch of GTA 6 this November is actually going to be a massive win for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4! They're banking on the sheer hype around Rockstar's behemoth to bring more players to their consoles, creating a rising tide that lifts all gaming boats. Activision’s chief marketing officer even called COD and GTA the "two biggest games of the year" (sorry, Zelda!). This strategy is all about getting those dusty consoles fired up and getting more eyeballs on the gaming landscape, which sounds like a win for everyone who loves to play.

title: PlayStation Plus Game Catalog October 2026 Lineup Confirmed
take: Your October 2026 PlayStation Plus lineup is looking absolutely stacked, folks! Get ready to dive into some serious narrative gold with Mafia: The Old Country, a prequel that scored a fantastic 8/10 for its writing and world. Plus, don't even get us started on Horizon Forbidden West, a 9/10 first-party masterpiece that's perfect for exploring. And for those Premium subscribers, a dose of classic survival horror awaits with Dino Crisis 2. Seriously, grab your controllers – this month’s additions are a gaming buffet!

title: Over 1 Million Characters Have Been Made in the WoW Forever Beta
take: WoW Forever's beta is absolutely crushing it, with over a million characters already created! That's a huge milestone, especially since most players had to shell out $30 for the Skyborne pack just to get in. Forget those fancy blue elves, it looks like good old Humans and Undead are still the fan favorites for Alliance and Horde respectively. This massive beta turnout, even with a level 30 cap and a full character wipe before launch, is a seriously good sign for Blizzard – even if GTA 6 looms!

title: The Best Controllers for Playing PC Games in 2026
take: Forget searching for your next PC controller, because the future of gaming input is already here! IGN has crowned the Flydigi Vader 5 Pro the champion of 2026, and after weeks of serious testing, we're not surprised. Those clicky mechanical buttons, fantastic battery life, and Hall Effect thumbsticks with adjustable tension are a game-changer, especially for us casual players who want to avoid dreaded stick drift. Just remember, if you're a symmetrical stick fan or need a supersized pad, you might need to keep hunting.

title: Tekken 8 Yujiro Teaser Reveals Baki Rep's In-Game Render Is Just as Uncanny as Fans Expected
take: Tekken 8's latest reveal has Baki fans buzzing with the first look at DLC character Yujiro Hanma! Bandai Namco dropped a teaser at Evo France 2026, and Yujiro's in-game render is exactly the uncanny, muscle-bound menace we all expected. While kangaroo-and-joey duo Roger Jr. steals most of the new trailer's spotlight with gameplay dropping November 11, the "Ogre" himself is still a ways off. Get ready to mark your calendars because a full Yujiro trailer is set to premiere at the Tekken World Tour Finals on January 17, 2027, where we’re definitely hoping for a release date and some crushing gameplay!

title: GTA 6 Leaker Threatens to Release Build With Full Story Mode Played to the End, Ties Lucia's Clothing to Crypto Scheme
take: Well, this is certainly a wild ride for GTA 6! A leaker is threatening to drop a full story mode playthrough if their memecoin hits a whopping $30 million market cap, all while claiming it’s a protest for physical game discs. While the market cap is nowhere near that massive target, the audacity of tying Lucia's outfits to crypto investments is just... something else. Rockstar is definitely having a rough time keeping things under wraps, but let's hope this crypto-fueled drama doesn't spoil too much of the fun before we can actually play the game!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Rollout Adds DMZ Early Access
take: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is pulling out all the stops for pre-order players, now offering early access to the revamped DMZ mode alongside the campaign! Infinity Ward is clearly taking a big swing at making DMZ the definitive extraction shooter, promising persistent progression in the new Hajin Exclusion Zone. After the original DMZ was deemed a bit of an "underwhelming prototype," it's exciting to see Activision give it another shot, especially for those of us who love a good open-world combat sandbox. So, if you've pre-ordered, mark your calendars for October 20th – it's time to see if this "fully fleshed-out evolution" lives up to the hype!

title: Tekken 8’s Reina Teased as the Next Guest Character for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
take: Get ready for a serious power-up in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves! Tekken 8's electrifying Reina is dropping into the roster as a guest character, and honestly, it just makes sense. While the game has gone a bit wild with guest fighters (we’re looking at you, Cristiano Ronaldo), trading blows with another legendary fighting franchise is pure genius. After all, Geese Howard crashed the Tekken party, so it's high time Bandai Namco returned the favor. We can't wait to see how Reina's tough-to-master Mishima School style translates into Fatal Fury's universe. Get ready to rumble this December!

title: Today Only: Save Over 50% Off a 2TB Internal SSD for Steam Deck or ROG Ally
take: Gamers, listen up! If your Steam Deck or ROG Ally is bursting at the seams, today’s your lucky day to grab a serious storage upgrade. Best Buy is slashing over 50% off a massive 2TB internal SSD, bringing the price down to $259.99 – a steal compared to its usual $531.99, especially with storage prices going wild thanks to AI companies! While it means some DIY tinkering to install, imagine never deleting a game again to make space for that new release. If cracking open your handheld sounds scary, you can also snag a 2TB microSD card for the same price, no tools required! This deal is fleeting, so don’t miss out on expanding your portable gaming universe.

title: Amazon Restocks Rare Pokémon TCG Sets for Prime Day
take: Heads up, trainers! If you're looking to expand your Pokémon TCG collection, Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days have brought some sweet restocks! While maybe not a colossal haul, we're still seeing some fantastic finds, especially the First Partner Illustration Collection Series 3. This is huge for collectors, as it finally wraps up the entire First Partner series, bringing in those adorable starters from Hoenn, Kalos, and Paldea. Plus, with prices matching market value, scoring these on Amazon, especially with Prime shipping, is a no-brainer. Go catch 'em all!

title: Everything We Saw at RuneFest 2026, Including RuneScape 4 and RuneScape Reignited
take: RuneFest 2026 just dropped a treasure trove of news for RuneScape fans, and wow, are we excited! Not only is RuneScape 4 (or RS4 as a working title) officially in development on Unreal Engine, promising a truly next-gen adventure, but Jagex is also reigniting the classic game with RuneScape Reignited. This December 2nd launch will bring a fresh economy, new hi-scores, and free access for a limited time to lure back lapsed players. Plus, Old School RuneScape is finally opening the Golden Gates to Menaphos after 20 years – talk about a long-awaited homecoming! And let's not forget the new animated adaptation and a massive roadmap of content across all titles. It's a fantastic time to be a 'Scaper!

title: Love and Deepspace Devs Issue Warning to Players After Deadly Drink Recipes Go Viral
take: Woah there, Love and Deepspace players! The devs just had to issue a warning about their new "Shimmering Blend" cocktail recipes, and for good reason. Turns out, some of those gorgeous in-game garnishes, like datura and flame lilies, are actually super poisonous in real life. While we totally get wanting to mix up a drink inspired by your favorite character, please, for the love of all that is shiny, do NOT try to recreate these at home! Stick to the virtual sips and leave the real-world botanical experiments to the experts (and definitely not with deadly plants). Play safe, drink (virtually) responsibly!

title: Brand New GTA 6 Screenshots Focus on Lucia and Jason's Relationship
take: Rockstar just dropped some seriously juicy new GTA 6 screenshots, and they're all about the dynamic duo, Lucia and Jason! We’re seeing them go from casual diner chats (heist planning or a lover’s spat? We can’t wait to find out!) to fierce pool sharks in a biker bar. This pair is aiming for the American Dream, not billionaire status, and Rockstar's narrative VP says they're all about creating a "more over the top, more insane" world. Get ready for some deeply flawed, authentic characters trying to make it big – or at least pay off their debts – in Vice City!

title: The Art of Metaphor: ReFantazio Book Is Now Available To Preorder, Out Next March
take: Obsessed with Metaphor: ReFantazio? Get ready to dive even deeper into IGN’s 2024 Game of the Year because "The Art of Metaphor: ReFantazio" hardcover art book is available for preorder now! This gorgeous release, priced at $50, drops March 9, 2027, and it’s absolutely packed with behind-the-scenes details, concept art, character sketches, and insights into the game’s narrative and gameplay. Seriously, it’s already sold out at some retailers, so if you’re a superfan, snagging this stunning collection of gaming goodness now is probably a smart move!

title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Nintendo Switch 2 Can Be Unlocked for Free Even if You Borrow a Switch Physical Copy From a Friend
take: Get ready to channel your inner Geralt on the Switch 2 for absolutely free (with a friend's help)! CD Projekt Red is making good on their promise, allowing any physical copy of The Witcher 3 for the original Switch to unlock the glorious Remastered edition on the new console. This means you can borrow, rent, or even quickly buy and trade back a cartridge to permanently bag a digital copy packed with combat upgrades, a revamped skill tree, armor transmog, and tons of visual enhancements like ray tracing. Forget keeping the cartridge inserted – once unlocked, it's yours to enjoy, including both original expansions, until the paid "Songs of the Past" arrives next year. Talk about a generous way to dive into monster hunting!

title: Sony and Nintendo Should Keep the Current Gen Going for as Long as Possible 'Because People Are Very Happy Using PS5 and Switch 2,' Former PlayStation Exec Says
take: Former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida is dropping some wisdom, suggesting Sony and Nintendo should keep the PS5 and Switch 2 humming along as long as possible! With console prices already soaring thanks to "RAMageddon" and manufacturing woes, it makes total sense. Gamers are happy with their current systems, and honestly, who wants to shell out a grand for a PS6 when the PS5 Pro already costs $900? Developers aren't even screaming for more power, so let's enjoy our current-gen gems for a while longer!

title: Save Up to $1,000 Off CORSAIR Prebuilt Gaming PCs With Nvidia GeForce RTX GPUs for This Week Only
take: Big news for PC gamers looking to upgrade their setup! CORSAIR is dropping some serious discounts – up to a whopping $1,000 off – on their VENGEANCE and CORSAIR ONE prebuilt gaming PCs, but only for this week. These aren't just any systems; they come packed with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs and are hand-assembled with top-tier, non-proprietary components, meaning future upgrades are a breeze. If you've been eyeing a beast like the VENGEANCE a7500 with its RTX 5080 and Ryzen 7 9800X3D, now’s your moment to snag a deal and dive into those high-fidelity browser games!

title: Corsair Gaming Headsets See Early Prime Big Deal Days Discounts on Amazon UK
take: Thinking about upgrading your audio setup for those intense gaming sessions? You're in luck! Amazon UK is dropping some sweet early deals on Corsair gaming headsets even before Prime Big Deal Days officially starts. The Corsair VOID v2 wireless headset, a real looker with its earcup lighting and Dolby Atmos, is rocking a 30% discount at £69.99. With 70-hour battery life and multi-platform support (PC, PlayStation, Switch, mobile!), it's perfect for tracking every enemy footstep in Dead by Daylight or keeping tabs on proximity chat in ARC Raiders. Don't sleep on these pre-Prime deals if you're chasing that competitive edge!

title: Minecraft LIVE September 2026 Live Report — All the News as It Happens
take: Minecraft LIVE just dropped a treasure chest of news, and we're buzzing! Mojang promised "game drops" and "behind-the-scenes secrets," and they delivered, even if the Minecraft Dungeons 2 reveal was expected with its September 29th launch. But the real game-changer? That blink-and-you'll-miss-it Eye of Ender and Enderman in the trailer has fans hoping for a massive End update. Considering the End dimension hasn't had a proper refresh since 2016, this would be HUGE for the best-selling game of all time. We're talking a megaton of new gameplay for all you explorers out there!

title: PlayStation Reportedly Polling Game Developers After Decision to Kill Discs Sparks Backlash
take: Looks like PlayStation might be feeling the heat after their decision to ditch physical game discs! Rumors are swirling that Sony is now sending out super-long surveys to game developers, slyly asking for feedback on how they sell physical games. Fans and devs alike have been vocal about their displeasure, and it seems even the mightiest console maker can't ignore a good old-fashioned outcry. While execs still talk an all-digital future, this survey suggests they might be reconsidering if enough developers speak up. Could this be a small win for disc collectors everywhere? We can hope!

title: The 4K-Ready MSI Codex Z2 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC Drops to $1,699 After a $600 Discount
take: Looking to dive into glorious 4K gaming without selling a kidney? Walmart just dropped a jaw-dropping deal on the MSI Codex Z2 gaming PC, slashed by $600 to a sweet $1,699! This bad boy packs an RTX 5070 Ti, which is a total beast for crushing games like Death Stranding 2 and Crimson Desert at 60+fps in 4K – no sweat. Plus, that 5070 Ti alone usually costs almost a grand, so grabbing this whole prebuilt rig is basically a steal and the only way to get your hands on this powerful Blackwell card without a huge markup. If you've been dreaming of ultra-crisp, smooth visuals, now's your chance!

title: Scrapped GTA 5 Story DLC Might Have Taken the Series Overseas for the First Time in 15 Years
take: Ever wonder what became of GTA 5's lost story DLC? Well, new leaks reveal that Rockstar almost took players to Paris – a first for the series in 15 years! Imagine Trevor as a secret agent, jet-setting to a swanky Parisian apartment overlooking the Eiffel Tower. While it seems the overseas adventure might have been limited to a killer cutscene or assassination, it’s a peek at how close we were to a truly global Grand Theft Auto. Sadly, Red Dead Redemption 2 and GTA Online’s massive success ultimately sidelined this cool concept, proving that even awesome ideas sometimes get cancelled for bigger fish.

title: Microsoft Signals Intention to Close Down Ninja Theory After Deals to Save the Hellblade Developer Fall Through
take: Talk about a plot twist! It seems Ninja Theory, the brilliant minds behind the *Hellblade* series, are facing the ultimate boss battle: closure. Microsoft has signaled its intent to shut down the studio after two deals to save them fell through, which is absolutely wild given they just announced *Senua*, the third *Hellblade* game, a few months ago. We're talking serious whiplash for fans and the studio alike! While Microsoft says they're still open to a last-minute rescue, and we've seen studios like Double Fine and Compulsion go independent with their IP, it's a grim outlook for Senua's future. Our fingers are crossed for a miracle – we need more of that unique *Hellblade* magic!

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 Is Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 – Here’s Where You Can Preorder It
take: Whoa, big news for medieval RPG fans with Nintendo Switch 2 on their radar! Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 is officially heading to the new console next year, and it's even a Royal Edition. This is a huge win for those who love deep, historical adventures and were worried about missing out on the sequel without a high-end PC or other console. While the exact release date is still a mystery, you can already lock in your preorder at Amazon – grab it for $59.99 and be ready to dive into 15th-century Bohemia on the go!

title: Hideo Kojima Reveals What Happened With Sony in Exclusive First Interview Since PlayStation Ditched Physint
take: Whoa, talk about a plot twist! Hideo Kojima just spilled the tea on what really went down with Sony and Physint. Apparently, PlayStation pulled the plug on funding for the Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor, leaving Kojima stunned and worried for his studio’s future. But fear not, gamers, because Xbox swooped in to save the day, snatching up Physint in what’s being called one of the wildest console switches ever. Looks like we might be playing this one on Xbox after all!

title: As Fans Flood the World of Warcraft: Forever Beta, Dev Says It's Putting Up 'The Craziest Numbers I've Seen in 17 Years Working at Blizzard'
take: World of Warcraft: Forever’s beta is absolutely blowing up, surprising even Blizzard! Turns out, a "Classic Plus" take on WoW's early days is exactly what players craved, with one dev calling the beta numbers "the craziest" he's seen in 17 years. While the initial flood caused some major lag and disconnects (classic beta problems, right?), Blizzard quickly smoothed things out. Now, players are raving about the updated visuals and sound, making this nostalgic trip feel fresh. Looks like November 4th can't come soon enough for this runaway hit!
